findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Observed the inside bottom surface of the prep cooler to have an accumulation of food debris. Discussed with PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces of equipment are cleaned as frequent as necessary to preclude accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
There wasn’t any hand soap in the men’s bathroom at the start of the inspection. Discussed with PIC and hand soap was provided. Be sure that hand soap is available at every hand-sink to ensure that hands are getting washed correctly.  

6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed the ice shoot of the Pepsi machine to have an accumulation of pink slime. Discussed and shown to PIC. PIC mentioned that Pepsi will be contacted to service the machine. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent slime accumulation. Will follow-up on the violation on 12/27/2024. 

4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Overall, floors, walls, ceilings, and around equipment are in need of a deep cleaning. Observed dust, food splatter, and debris throughout the kitchen area. Discussed with PIC. Ensure physical facilities are cleaned as often as necessary to prevent accumulation.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
2-101.11: No one present has a firm understanding of operations and procedures.There is not a certified food protection manager present. See that someone certified is present during all hours when food is being prepared and served. spoke with manager and SCDPH will be meeting on Monday at 10am to address the violations.



(A) PERMIT HOLDER shall be PIC or shall designate PIC and ensure the PIC is present during all hours of operation. (B) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT with multiple departments on same PREMISES can designate single PIC when food is not being prepared.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: (A) The person in charge is not a CFPM. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) There are no signed employee health papers for staff.


FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: The facility does not have a Norovirus clean-up policy available. See that a policy for cleaning-up vomit and diarrhea is available and shared with staff.
A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-201.11: Observed a spray bottle labeled bleach water to be stored between spray bottle of water and meat slicer.Moved to the floor during the inspection. Also, observed a bottle of window cleaner stored below the island counter between oils. moved to chemical storage shelf during the inspection.

 (A)-(B) POISONOUS MATERIALS shall be stored to prevent contamination of FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES by separating or locating MATERIALS in area away or below FOOD and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES (use partition or store below).

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-501.14: The wash sink and Sani sink of the triple sink are observed soiled with soil and molds. Clean before use.


 WAREWASHING machine or other receptacles used for cleaning EQUIPMENT and other equipment used for drain boards shall be cleaned before use, throughout day to prevent recontamination as necessary, and at least every 24 hours.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Obseved the facility to have many corners and walls where soil and food crumbs are accumulating. See that the sides of the mop sink are cleaned as well as the handles of equipment.


NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Observed the triple sink to need caulking to the wall. Also, observed the mop sink and hand sink to have caulking that is molded and lacking. Clean and reseal the sinks to the walls.
Both bathrooms have damage to the baseboard causing it to pull from the wall. Seal the baseboard in the bathrooms to the wall. Repair the wall under the soap dispenser in the womens bathroom so the drywall paper is properly sealed. See that the hand sinks are cleaned to prevent contamination of hands during hand washing.


PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) There are no current food handler cards available within the facility. All present documents are from 2014, 2017, or 2020. Provide current food handler cards for staff

Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed an employee wash his hands and not use a barrier to turn the faucet off. Ensure a barrier is used to turn the faucet off. Education provided during the inspection. 
2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Observed the soda nozzles that are used more often to be soiled with mold and other build up. Ensure that soda nozzles are routinely cleaned so they are maintained clean to sight and touch. Soda nozzles were removed for cleaning during the inspection. 
(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: Observed the soda nozzles that are used more often to be soiled with gunky soda build up. Ensure that soda nozzles are routinely cleaned so they are maintained clean to sight and touch. The manager stated the soda nozzles would be cleaned today to correct the violation. 
(A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: Observed the area behind the ice dispenser and the areas behind the soda nozzles to have old soda debris and pink mildew build up. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned routinely to avoid the accumulation of soil residues. 
NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Soda nozzles are soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observered chaulking at handsink to be insufficient. Soap dispenser in women's bathroom was replaced and causing paper from wallboard to peel away. Maintain surfaces to be smooth, nonabsorbant, and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Dried and crusted debris present on ladels used for soups.  Ladels were discarded upon request

750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
Observed dressing squirt bottles and the handle to the knife to be stored in contact with the lettuce on the prep table. It was discussed that bottoms of squirt bottles should not be stored in direct contact with a ready to eat food, and that knife handle should always be stored up and out of the food.
750-160  Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the nozzles to the soda fountain to have an accumulation of friable black mold. Nozzles were removed to be cleaned during the inspection.
750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Observed the self closer to the men's restroom door to be missing. Replace self closer.
750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Approved source
findings.comment: Observed facility cooling soup in the back reach in cooler. Employee states opener made 2 batches of broccoli cheese soup and one batch was probed at 106F in the cooler. Soup was discarded as cooling and reheating is outside the limits of a medium risk facility. 750.100

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: Observed pre-packaged brownies and cookies to not have ingredient list available. All baked goods packaged in advance of retail sale must have a label with 1) name of the product, 2) address where made, 3) net contents, 4) ingredient list, 5) allergens, artificial flavors.

findings.title: Foods properly cooled
findings.comment: Observed broccoli cheese soup cooling in the back reach in cooler since 12:50 pm to be probed at 106F at 4 pm. Facility is not allowed to cool, however, if going to cool, item must be labeled with the time the cooling process begins to ensure it reaches 70F within 2 hours and 41F or below within an additional 4 hours. Soup was discarded 750.140

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Observed thermometers in reach in cooler and prep cooler to read 29F. Actual temperature in the coolers is 36-40F. Provide thermometers to be accurate to within +/- 3F. 750.140

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed the top of the oven in the back to be rusted and caved in with some sort of insulation exposed. Repair top of oven so it is smooth and easily cleanable. 750.690

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the ice chute on the soda fountain machine to have friable mold on it. Clean and sanitize ice chute. 750.800

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 1) Observed the drain on the hand sink to have an accumulation of black, friable mold. 2) Observed the handles on the prep cooler to be soiled. Clean these non-food contact surfaces. 750.800

findings.title: Sewage and waste water disposed properly
findings.comment: Observed dirty mop water in the mop bucket under the prep sink in the kitchen. Discard mop water after use. 750.1050

findings.comment: Observed a leak at the faucet to the 3 compartment sink when faucet is off. Repair faucet. 750.1060

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: Observed gaps in the floor in the women's restroom. Repair floors so they are smooth and easily cleanable. 750.1200

findings.comment:
1) Observed the touch points such as handles of coolers and the handle on the sandwich oven to be soiled with food accumulation. Clean these touch points regularly with sanitizer to help keep hands and gloves clean and sanitary when handling food. 2) Observed the soda fountain to have soda splash on the back splash guard. Clean the soda fountain. 
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed the threshold leading into the women's restroom to have approximately a 1" gap between the tile in the dining room and the wood in the restroom. Provide some sort of threshold to seal this area of the floor so that it is smooth and easily cleanable.
750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed a container of BBQ prepared at the facility to not be date marked. Facility states BBQ sauce was prepared last Friday. Container was date marked suring inspection. Potentially hazardous foods held over 24 hours must be date marked on the date prepared and held no longer than 7 days. 
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
1) Observed the handle on the bottom of the prep cooler to be broken. Replace this plastic handle to procide for surfaces to be free from crevices.
750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
1) CORRECTED> Observed a moist, heavily soiled rag to be hanging on the faucet of the mop sink. Rag was discarded during inspection. Wet wiping cloths should be stored in sanitizer solution in between use. Rags used to clean the oven should be laundered or discarded (if no longer capable of coming clean) at least daily and stored in sanitizer solution in between use.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the bottom of the sandwich toaster to be soiled with char. 2) Observed the handles on the top of the prep cooler to be soiled with food accumulation. 3) Observed food debris on the top of the oven in the back. Clean these areas as often as necessary to keep them free from debris.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Observed the mop head to be stored in the wringer part of the mop bucket. Store mops hanging or inverted to dry.
750-1390 Maintenance and cleaning tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners and similiar equipment shall be maintained and stored in a way that does not contaminate food.
